name: evoq-ui
idScheme: evoq-ui:<component name without the Ev prefix, kebab-case>. Stable across layer moves.

components.name: EvAccordion
components.summary: A collapsible section: a header button with a title and optional subtext that shows or hides its panel.

props.name: separator
props.description: Whether to show the bottom separator rule in the default variant.

components.name: EvAlert
components.summary: Communicate a persistent, in-page message about the status of a page, section, or action.

props.name: inverse
props.description: Swaps the tinted alert for a solid fill with inverse text.

props.name: subtext
props.description: Supporting line. Its presence switches the alert to the taller layout.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Renders the dismiss button and enables the `close` event.

components.name: EvAlertDialog
components.summary: A blocking dialog that asks the user to confirm or decide - traps focus, closes on Escape, and restores focus on close.

props.name: layout
props.description: `desktop` uses the board's large illustration; `compact` uses the mobile layout, where the artwork becomes a 40px icon tile and the buttons stack.

props.name: closeOnScrim
props.description: Set false to force a deliberate choice from the buttons.

components.name: EvAspectRatio
components.summary: A box that holds one media element at a fixed width-to-height ratio, filling it with the media and clipping the overflow.

props.name: ratio
props.description: One of the ratios drawn in Figma, or any `w:h` / `w/h` pair.

components.name: EvAvatar
components.summary: An avatar represents a user or entity through an image, initials, or icon, helping provide identity and context within the interface.

props.name: variant
props.description: Tint of the initials avatar, or one of the three grey states: `number` for an overflow count, `empty` for no person, `error` for a failed image.

props.name: label
props.description: Initials, or the count for the `number` variant.

props.name: src
props.description: Shows the photo instead of the initials.

props.name: alt
props.description: Accessible name. Falls back to the initials.

components.name: EvAvatarGroup
components.summary: A labelled, overlapping stack of avatars that share one size.

props.name: size
props.description: Must match the size of the avatars inside - it sets the overlap.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the stack.

components.name: EvBadge
components.summary: A badge is a small, color-coded label that communicates an item's status, category, or count using concise text.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Figma's `Reverse Colors` property: swaps the tinted badge for a solid fill with inverse text.

components.name: EvBarChart
components.summary: A bar chart - grouped or stacked - drawn in SVG from an array of records.

props.name: category
props.description: Key holding each row's category - the X axis.

props.name: series
props.description: One key per series. Several keys give the board's GroupBarChart.

props.name: type
props.description: `stacked` stacks the series within one column instead of clustering.

props.name: showValues
props.description: Figma's `Has Value`: the figure above each bar.

props.name: seriesLabels
props.description: Names used in the tooltip. Falls back to the series keys.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible description of what the chart shows.

components.name: EvBreadcrumb
components.summary: Show the user's location within a hierarchy and let them navigate back to any ancestor level.

props.name: maxItems
props.description: Collapse the middle of the trail once there are more crumbs than this, matching Figma's `Ellipsis` variant. `0` never collapses.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the trail.

components.name: EvButton
components.summary: A button triggers an action or submits a form — the primary way users commit to a decision in a form, card, dialog, or toolbar.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual weight of the button.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height: 40px (`default`) or 32px (`small`).

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner and blocks interaction.

props.name: block
props.description: Stretch to the full width of the parent.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Render as a square control holding only an icon. Pass the icon through the `iconLeft` slot, and give the button an `aria-label` - there is no visible text for a screen reader to announce.

components.name: EvButtonGroup
components.summary: Group related action buttons horizontally so they share borders and read as one control.

props.name: variant
props.description: Applied to every item unless one overrides it.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the control.

components.name: EvButtonGroupItem
components.summary: One segment of a ButtonGroup - a button that takes its variant and size from the group around it.

props.name: variant
props.description: Overrides the group's variant for this one item.

props.name: active
props.description: Marks this item as the current choice.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Square item holding only an icon. Give it an `aria-label`.

components.name: EvButtonLink
components.summary: A button link is a text-only, inline action styled as a link — used for low-emphasis or navigational actions where a full button would be too heavy.

props.name: href
props.description: Renders an anchor instead of a button.

props.name: current
props.description: The link is the current item - a breadcrumb's page. Pins the variant's `State=Active` look and sets `aria-current="page"`; without an `href` it renders as plain text, since the current page is not a destination.

components.name: EvCalendar
components.summary: A date picker for a single date or a range, with day, month, year and full-calendar views, presets, and desktop and mobile layouts.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: A single date, or a `[from, to]` pair in range mode.

props.name: view
props.description: Which grid to draw. `month` and `year` are the board's `Month` / `Year` variants, and the same two grids back the desktop `Month Open` and `Year Open` overlays.

props.name: platform
props.description: `desktop` is the `D - Calendar` board; `mobile` is `M - CalendarPopup` - bare chevrons, a value read-out above the footer, and footer buttons split evenly rather than sitting right-aligned.

props.name: fullMonths
props.description: How many month blocks the `full` view stacks.

props.name: monthOpen
props.description: Figma's `Month Open` / `Year Open` overlays on the desktop header.

props.name: month
props.description: The month on view. Uncontrolled unless you pass it.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for the month name and weekday initials.

props.name: events
props.description: Dates to mark with the board's event dot.

props.name: presets
props.description: Figma's `Basic Preset` / `Range Preset`: the quick-select row below the grid.

props.name: hasReset
props.description: Figma's `Has Reset Button` on the footer row.

props.name: showTimeLink
props.description: The board's `Select Time` link, drawn under the Basic variant.

props.name: footer
props.description: Draws the Cancel / Apply footer on the single-date Basic variant, which the board draws without one. Range, Preset and mobile always have it. Opt-in, for a calendar hosted in an InputDate slot.

components.name: EvCard
components.summary: A bordered block that frames one subject: optional image, title and description, header action, body and footer.

components.name: EvCarousel
components.summary: A carousel displays a set of items in a scrollable horizontal or vertical track, with previous/next navigation buttons and a position indicator. It supports multiple content aspect ratios.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Index of the slide in view.

props.name: ratio
props.description: Applied to every slide. The usage doc is explicit that one carousel keeps a single ratio throughout, so it lives here rather than on each slide.

props.name: showButtons
props.description: Figma's `Need Button`: the previous/next controls.

props.name: showIndicator
props.description: Figma's `Has Indicator Slot`: the position dots.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the carousel.

components.name: EvCarouselSlide
components.summary: One slide of a Carousel, drawn as an Aspect Ratio box at the carousel's ratio.

components.name: EvChart
components.summary: The titled frame a chart sits in: title, subtext, header action, summary and legend around the chart slot.

props.name: variant
props.description: `card` wraps the chart in a surface; `no-card` renders it bare.

props.name: subtext
props.description: Figma's `Has Subtext`: a muted line under the title - a range or unit.

components.name: EvCheckbox
components.summary: A checkbox lets users select one or more options from a set, or toggle a single setting on or off. It supports checked, unchecked, indeterminate, disabled, and error states.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Renders the dash instead of the tick. Independent of `modelValue`, the same way the DOM's own `indeterminate` flag is.

props.name: error
props.description: Draws the error border and tints the subtext.

components.name: EvCommand
components.summary: A command palette (⌘K) lets users search and run actions from anywhere — a searchable, keyboard-navigable list of commands grouped into sections.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: The search field's value.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Caps the list and lets it scroll. The board draws two 140-tall Sections.

components.name: EvCommandGroup
components.summary: One Section of a Command palette: a muted heading row over its commands, with the rule that separates it from the section above.

props.name: heading
props.description: The "Section Title" row the board draws at the top of each Section.

components.name: EvCommandItem
components.summary: One command in a Command palette: a leading icon, a label, an optional shortcut cap, and a check when it is the chosen row.

props.name: href
props.description: Renders a real link instead of an option button.

props.name: active
props.description: Figma's `State=Active`: the row currently chosen, marked with a check.

props.name: heading
props.description: The board builds its "Section Title" rows out of this same node with every icon and cap switched off. A heading is not selectable.

props.name: hasChevron
props.description: Draws the trailing chevron instead of nothing. Ignored when active.

components.name: EvDataTable
components.summary: A data table presents structured rows and columns with sortable headers, filters, selection, and pagination — built for scanning, comparing, and acting on large datasets.

props.name: variant
props.description: `Variant` of the Figma `Data Table` set.

props.name: title
props.description: The caption above the table.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name, when there is no visible title.

components.name: EvDataTableCell
components.summary: One cell of a DataTable - a th in the header with an optional sort control, a td in the body. Whatever the cell holds goes in its slot.

props.name: header
props.description: Renders a `th` in the header row rather than a `td` in the body.

props.name: sortable
props.description: Draws the sort glyph the board puts on every `.Table Item` in a title row.

props.name: sort
props.description: Which way the column is sorted right now.

props.name: fixed
props.description: Pins the column while the table scrolls sideways.

props.name: offset
props.description: Distance from the pinned edge, for a second pinned column.

components.name: EvDataTableRow
components.summary: One row of a DataTable: it carries the selected state and, for a tree, the indent level that picks its fill off the tree ramp.

props.name: level
props.description: Figma's `State=Level 1` .. `Level 5`: how deep the row sits in a tree, which is what picks its fill off the `tree/*` ramp. 0 is `State=Default`.

props.name: selected
props.description: Figma's `State=Selected`.

props.name: header
props.description: Renders the row inside `thead` and drops the hover fill.

components.name: EvDirection
components.summary: A panel that guides one short task: title and subtext, an optional header action, a body, and confirm / cancel footer slots.

props.name: hasHeaderAction
props.description: Figma's `Has Icon Right`: the trailing element in the header. On by default - the usage doc says not to hide the close affordance.

props.name: hasConfirm
props.description: Figma's `Has Confirmation Button`: the primary action in the footer. Turn it off for a read-only panel that only needs a dismiss.

components.name: EvDrawer
components.summary: A panel that slides in from the right, left or bottom over a scrim - traps focus, closes on Escape, and restores focus on close.

props.name: placement
props.description: Which edge it slides from. `bottom` is the board's mobile sheet.

props.name: header
props.description: Draw the header at all. The board's `M- Drawer` hides the whole header frame with its `Header` property - title, subtext and close together.

components.name: EvDropdownItem
components.summary: One row of a DropdownList: an option in a listbox, or a menu item - a real link when given an href - inside a menu.

props.name: variant
props.description: `list` is the plain 24px row; `list-box` is the taller 32px row the board uses once a checkbox or avatar sits beside the label.

props.name: active
props.description: Figma's `Active` state - the currently chosen option.

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the row a real link - for a menu of destinations, such as a breadcrumb's hidden crumbs. It keeps native link behaviour (open in a new tab, copy address) that a scripted option would lose.

components.name: EvDropdownList
components.summary: A floating list panel - a listbox of options to choose from, or a menu of actions and links - with optional search, scrolling and an empty state.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Figma's `Has Search`: turns the list into the Combobox pattern.

props.name: scrollable
props.description: Figma's `Has Scroll`: caps the visible height. Off by default - the doc says scrolling still works without it. Override the cap itself with `--ev-dropdown-list-max-height`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the option list.

props.name: menu
props.description: A menu of actions or links rather than a listbox of options to choose from - the rows become menu items, and a row with `href` a real link.

components.name: EvDropdownMenu
components.summary: A floating menu of actions opened from a trigger, with an optional search field and a list that scrolls when it outgrows the surface.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Figma's `Search` frame, hidden by default on the board.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Caps the list and lets it scroll. The board's `Scroll` rail is 320 tall.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the menu.

components.name: EvDropdownMenuItem
components.summary: One row of a DropdownMenu: an action, a destructive action, a group heading, or the rule between two groups.

props.name: subtext
props.description: Second line under the label. Figma's `Has Subtext`.

props.name: href
props.description: Renders a real link instead of a menu item button.

props.name: error
props.description: Figma's `State=Error`: a destructive entry, such as Delete.

props.name: submenu
props.description: Figma's `State=Submenu`: the muted 12px row the board uses to head a group of entries. It is a label, not a control.

props.name: separator
props.description: Figma's `State=Separator`: a rule between two groups.

props.name: hasChevron
props.description: Draws the trailing chevron that says the entry opens a submenu.

components.name: EvEmptyState
components.summary: An empty state fills a screen or container when there's no content to show — errors (400 / 401 / 404 / 500), maintenance, or simply no data / no results. It pairs an illustration with a message and an optional recovery action.

props.name: variant
props.description: `Variant` of the Figma `D - Empty State` / `M - Empty State` sets.

props.name: size
props.description: Which of the two sets to follow: the desktop one or the mobile one.

props.name: title
props.description: Overrides the variant's headline.

props.name: description
props.description: Overrides the variant's supporting line.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: The third line, which the board fills with a system error code.

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: Overrides the variant's button label. Set to '' to drop the button.

components.name: EvHint
components.summary: A hint is a small notification badge that signals unread or pending items — shown as a plain dot or a count, attached to an icon, tab, or menu item.

props.name: value
props.description: Count to display. Leave unset for the bare dot.

props.name: max
props.description: Counts above this render as `{max}+`, matching Figma's `99+` variant.

props.name: dot
props.description: Force the dot even when a value is given.

components.name: EvHoverCard
components.summary: A hover card is a small overlay that appears when the user hovers over a trigger, surfacing a preview — a title with an optional description and caption — without a click.

props.name: placement
props.description: Which side of the trigger the card sits on.

props.name: subtext
props.description: The 10px line under the description.

props.name: openDelay
props.description: Milliseconds the pointer has to rest before the card opens.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: Milliseconds before it closes again, so the pointer can cross the gap.

components.name: EvInput
components.summary: A single-line text input for collecting short free-form values. It supports leading/trailing icons, validation messaging, and multiple interaction states.

props.name: type
props.description: Any native input type - `text`, `search`, `email`, `number`, ...

props.name: size
props.description: Container size: default (44px) or small (32px) per Figma spec

props.name: label
props.description: Floating label, drawn notched into the field's top border.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field required and appends the board's red asterisk.

props.name: error
props.description: Switches the field to the error style. Always pair it with a message.

props.name: validationText
props.description: Helper text below the field. Turns red in the error state.

props.name: validationTextEnd
props.description: Trailing helper text, right-aligned - a counter or a hint.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Shows the clear button once there is something to clear.

props.name: revealable
props.description: For `type="password"`: draws the eye button that shows / hides the value. Not a node on the InputField board - added on request, drawn in the trailing-icon position with the same 20px glyph and colour.

components.name: EvInputDate
components.summary: A date input with a trailing calendar icon and a date-picker dropdown (slot). It comes in two sizes, supports validation, and shares the same interaction states as InputField.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: A single date, or a `[from, to]` pair in range mode.

props.name: mode
props.description: `single` for one date, `range` for a `[from, to]` pair. Set in code.

props.name: label
props.description: The notched Title.

props.name: required
props.description: Appends the board's red asterisk to the Title.

props.name: size
props.description: Figma's `Size`: default (44px) or small (36px).

props.name: open
props.description: Active state - the panel is open.

props.name: error
props.description: Switches the field to the error style. Pair it with `validationText`.

props.name: validationText
props.description: Figma's `Has Validation Text`.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Shows the clear button while open and holding a value.

props.name: hasRightIcon
props.description: Figma's `Has R Icon`: the trailing calendar glyph. On by default.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for the displayed value and the calendar.

components.name: EvInputDropdown
components.summary: A select-style input with a trailing chevron that opens a list of options (slot). It comes in two sizes (44px and 36px), supports a leading icon and validation, and shares the same interaction states as InputField.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: The displayed value. Empty shows the placeholder.

props.name: label
props.description: The notched Title.

props.name: required
props.description: Appends the board's red asterisk to the Title.

props.name: size
props.description: Figma's `Size`: default (44px) or small (36px).

props.name: open
props.description: Active state - the slot is open.

props.name: error
props.description: Switches the field to the error style. Pair it with `validationText`.

props.name: validationText
props.description: Figma's `Has Validation Text`.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Shows the clear button while open and holding a value.

components.name: EvInputFieldUnit
components.summary: A composite input pairing a leading unit selector (dropdown) with a text/number field. Use it for values that carry a unit — e.g. amount + currency, weight + unit. It supports validation and the same interaction states as InputField.

props.name: label
props.description: Title of the value field (`InputField`).

props.name: unitLabel
props.description: Title of the unit dropdown (`InputDropdown`).

props.name: unitPlaceholder
props.description: Shown in the dropdown while no unit is chosen - the board's `Select`.

components.name: EvInputMultipleField
components.summary: A multi-select input that displays chosen values as removable tags and opens a list of options (slot). It supports a leading icon, validation, and the same interaction states as InputField.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Values of the chosen tags.

props.name: options
props.description: Lets a value render its label; without a match the value itself shows.

props.name: label
props.description: `.Input` Title while nothing is chosen.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: `.Input` Placeholder line above the tags once something is chosen.

props.name: open
props.description: Active state - the slot is open.

components.name: EvInputMultipleOptions
components.summary: The multi-select options list (dropdown panel) that lets a user pick several values at once, each row toggled with a checkbox. It is typically mounted in the slot of InputMultipleField and supports validation and interaction states.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Values of the ticked rows.

props.name: label
props.description: `.Input` Title.

components.name: EvInputSearch
components.summary: A search input with a leading search icon and an optional clear action. Use it to filter or look up content. It is 44px tall and supports validation and interaction states.

props.name: leftIcon
props.description: Figma's `Has L Icon`: the leading search glyph. On by default.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Figma's `Has R Icon`: the trailing clear action, shown once there is a query.

components.name: EvInputSingleOptions
components.summary: The single-select options list (dropdown panel) that lets a user pick exactly one value from a list. It is typically mounted in the slot of InputDropdown and supports validation and interaction states.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Value of the selected row.

props.name: label
props.description: `.Input` Title.

components.name: EvInputTime
components.summary: A time input with a trailing clock icon and a time-picker dropdown (slot). It comes in two sizes, supports validation, and shares the same interaction states as InputField.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: `14:30` in 24-hour, `02:30 PM` in 12-hour; seconds when the format has them.

props.name: format
props.description: The wheel's columns. Follows the 24 / 12 hour switch.

props.name: hourSwitch
props.description: Shows the 24 jam / 12 jam switch above the wheel.

props.name: label
props.description: The notched Title.

props.name: required
props.description: Appends the board's red asterisk to the Title.

props.name: size
props.description: Figma's `Size`: default (44px) or small (36px).

props.name: open
props.description: Active state - the panel is open.

props.name: error
props.description: Switches the field to the error style. Pair it with `validationText`.

props.name: validationText
props.description: Figma's `Has Validation Text`.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Shows the clear button while open and holding a value.

props.name: hasRightIcon
props.description: Figma's `Has R Icon`: the trailing clock glyph. On by default.

components.name: EvInputWithLabel
components.summary: A single-line text input with an inline label placed to the left, right, or both sides of the field. It supports icons, validation, and the same interaction states as InputField.

props.name: prefixLabel
props.description: Text for left inline label prefix

props.name: suffixLabel
props.description: Text for right inline label suffix

props.name: placement
props.description: Position placement for inline labels

components.name: EvItem
components.summary: An item is a horizontal list row that pairs a leading element (icon, avatar, image) with a title and description, and an optional trailing action — used in lists, menus, and selection groups.

props.name: type
props.description: `Type` of the Figma `Item` set.

props.name: description
props.description: Caption under the title, inside the `.LabelItem` instance.

props.name: labelType
props.description: Passed straight through to the `.LabelItem` instance.

props.name: trailing
props.description: The trailing caption the board draws as a separate `Description` node.

components.name: EvKbd
components.summary: A Kbd (keyboard key) is a small inline chip that represents a single physical key or shortcut token — like Ctrl or ⇧ — used to document keyboard shortcuts.

props.name: variant
props.description: A text cap hugs its label; an icon cap is a 16px square.

props.name: light
props.description: Figma's `Light` property. Set to false for the dark cap.

components.name: EvLabelItem
components.summary: A title with a caption under it, at one of three caption sizes. The block Item, Sidebar and Command all reuse for their text.

props.name: type
props.description: `Type` of the Figma `.LabelItem` set - it only changes the caption size.

props.name: description
props.description: Caption under the title. Figma names the node `Description` on Default and `Label` on the two small types; it is one slot here.

components.name: EvLineChart
components.summary: A line or area chart for trends over time, drawn in SVG from an array of records.

props.name: category
props.description: Key holding each row's position on the X axis.

props.name: series
props.description: One key per series.

props.name: type
props.description: `area` fills the region beneath the trend, as the board's Area does.

props.name: seriesLabels
props.description: Names used in the tooltip. Falls back to the series keys.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible description of what the chart shows.

components.name: EvLoading
components.summary: A loading indicator communicates that content or an action is in progress, reassuring the user that the system is working and reducing perceived wait time.

props.name: type
props.description: `Type` of the Figma `Loading` set.

props.name: value
props.description: Progress from 0 to 100. Leave it unset and the progress bar runs indeterminate, which is what the board's animation frames draw.

props.name: label
props.description: Announced to assistive tech while the indicator is on screen.

components.name: EvLoadingOverlay
components.summary: A full-page loading state. Blocked mode covers the page with the EVOQ wordmark tracing itself over an 80% scrim and stops all interaction; popup mode is a small card with the spinner that leaves the page usable.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Whether the loader is on screen.

props.name: mode
props.description: `blocked` covers and blocks the page; `popup` is a small card that does not.

props.name: label
props.description: Announced to assistive tech, and shown in the popup card.

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: Escape turns it off (`update:modelValue` false). Off by default - a blocked loader is meant to stop the user; this is the way out for a playground or a stuck request.

components.name: EvLogo
components.summary: Both brand lockups from the Figma Logo page, drawn from shipped SVG: the EVOQ mark, wordmark and tagline, and the DataSea mark and wordmark. A local asset can replace them.

props.name: brand
props.description: Which lockup: the EVOQ product logo, or the DataSea company logo.

props.name: variant
props.description: The whole lockup, or one part of it on its own.

props.name: size
props.description: Rendered height, in px for a number. The width follows the lockup.

props.name: src
props.description: An image to use instead of the built-in logo - a local asset, or any URL. Leave it unset and the component draws the Figma logo.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Defaults to the brand's name; set it to an empty string for a logo that is purely decorative.

props.name: tagline
props.description: Draw the "Procure to Pay Evolution" line under the wordmark. Only the EVOQ lockup has one; DataSea ignores it.

components.name: EvModal
components.summary: A modal is a focused overlay dialog that interrupts the current flow to present information or request a decision, blocking interaction with the page behind it until dismissed. Available for desktop and mobile.

props.name: closable
props.description: Renders the close button in the header.

props.name: closeOnScrim
props.description: Set false to keep a click on the scrim from closing the modal.

components.name: EvNavMenuItem
components.summary: One destination in a NavigationMenu - a link when given an href, marked as the current section when active.

props.name: active
props.description: Marks the current section.

props.name: href
props.description: Renders an anchor instead of a button.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Figma's `Icon Only` state: a 32px square pill. Give it an `aria-label`, since there is no visible text.

components.name: EvNavMenuMobileItem
components.summary: One destination in the mobile navigation bar: a 24px icon over a 12px label, filling its share of the row.

props.name: active
props.description: Marks the current section. Figma models it as the `Active` variant.

props.name: href
props.description: Renders an anchor instead of a button.

components.name: EvNavigationMenu
components.summary: The navigation menu is the top-level horizontal bar that anchors a desktop app — pairing the brand logo with primary navigation links and utilities (search, profile) so users can orient and move between sections.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the bar.

components.name: EvNavigationMenuMobile
components.summary: The mobile navigation menu is a fixed bottom bar (393px) that holds the app's primary destinations as icon-plus-label tabs. Two styles: a standard bar and a variant with a raised center action button.

props.name: centerButton
props.description: Figma's `M - NavigationMenu CenterButton`: a raised round action in the middle of the bar, with a gap in the row where it sits.

components.name: EvPagination
components.summary: Pagination splits a large set of content or a multi-step flow into discrete pages, giving users controls to move between them and a sense of their position in the whole.

props.name: variant
props.description: `Variant` of the Figma `Pagination` set.

props.name: page
props.description: The page on screen, 1-based.

props.name: siblingCount
props.description: How many pages sit either side of the current one before an ellipsis.

props.name: rowsPerPage
props.description: `Pagination Display`: the number in the rows-per-page button.

props.name: stepLabel
props.description: `Pagination Step`: the caption. Left unset it reads "Step 2 of 5".

components.name: EvPaginationItem
components.summary: One page tile of a Pagination: a 32px square button, or the inert ellipsis standing in for a run of hidden pages.

props.name: page
props.description: The page this tile jumps to. Rendered as its label.

props.name: active
props.description: Marks the page currently on screen.

props.name: more
props.description: Figma's `State=More`: the ellipsis tile standing in for a run of hidden pages. It is inert, so it renders as a span rather than a button.

props.name: moreLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the ellipsis tile.

components.name: EvPieChart
components.summary: A pie or doughnut chart for part-to-whole proportions, drawn in SVG.

props.name: value
props.description: Key holding each slice's value.

props.name: category
props.description: Key holding each slice's name, used by the tooltip.

props.name: type
props.description: `pie` is a full circle, `doughnut` hollows the centre, and `doughnut-rounded` separates the segments and rounds their ends.

props.name: centralLabel
props.description: Text placed in the hollow centre. Ignored by the `pie` type.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible description of what the chart shows.

components.name: EvPopover
components.summary: A popover is a small floating panel anchored to a trigger, used to surface contextual content — a short form, details, or controls — on click, without navigating away from the current view.

props.name: placement
props.description: Which side of the trigger the panel sits on.

props.name: closeOnOutside
props.description: Set false to keep a click outside from closing it.

components.name: EvRadio
components.summary: A radio button lets users choose exactly one option from a set. Options are mutually exclusive — selecting one clears the others in the same group.

props.name: value
props.description: Value this radio contributes when selected.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Only used when the radio is not inside an `EvRadioGroup`.

components.name: EvRadioGroup
components.summary: Holds a set of radios under one name and one v-model, so exactly one of them is chosen.

props.name: name
props.description: Shared `name` for the underlying inputs. Generated when omitted.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every radio in the group.

props.name: error
props.description: Puts every radio in the group into the error state.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the group.

components.name: EvRichEditor
components.summary: A rich-text editor input with a formatting toolbar for entering styled, multi-line content. It supports leading/trailing icons, a scrollbar, validation, and the same interaction states as InputField.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: `.InputType` variant `Placeholder-default` - 14px, shown while empty.

props.name: label
props.description: `.InputType` variant `Title` - 12px, shown while empty instead of the placeholder.

props.name: required
props.description: The `Mandatory` boolean on `.InputType`: appends the red asterisk.

props.name: toolbar
props.description: Which `.RichEditor` type to draw: `big` is the 528px, 19-control bar; `small` is the 360px, 13-control one.

props.name: hasScroll
props.description: Figma's `Has Scroll`: reveals the 2px scrollbar once the body overflows.

props.name: showCount
props.description: Figma's `Has Validation Text`: the trailing character counter.

props.name: error
props.description: Figma's `Has Validation Error`: red border, red message.

props.name: validationText
props.description: The leading message. The board only reveals it in the two Error states.

components.name: EvScrollArea
components.summary: The scroll component is the thin scrollbar indicator shown alongside an overflowing container, signalling that more content is available and how far the user has scrolled.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Which axis may scroll.

props.name: mirror
props.description: Flips the scrollbar to the opposite edge (e.g. left side for vertical).

components.name: EvSeparator
components.summary: A separator is a thin line that visually divides content into groups — between list items, sections, or side-by-side elements — without adding emphasis.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Purely decorative rules are hidden from assistive tech. Leave this off when the rule actually separates two groups of content.

components.name: EvSidebar
components.summary: The sidebar is the vertical navigation rail along the edge of an app, holding the brand, search, primary navigation items, and the user account. It can expand or collapse on desktop and appears as a slide-in drawer on mobile. Available for desktop (D) and mobile (M).

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Figma's `Open=No`: the 64px rail that keeps only the icons.

props.name: mobile
props.description: Follow `M - Sidebar` instead of `D - Sidebar`: an account row and a full-width search where the desktop board puts the logo.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Figma's `Search` frame.

props.name: toggleLabel
props.description: The toggle's accessible name.

components.name: EvSidebarItem
components.summary: One row of a Sidebar: a destination at main, submenu or sub-submenu depth, or one of the two rows that are not controls - a section heading and a rule.

props.name: type
props.description: `Type` of the Figma `.ItemSidebar` set.

props.name: href
props.description: Renders a real link instead of a button.

props.name: active
props.description: Marks the current section. Figma's `State=Active`.

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Collapses the row to a 32px square holding only its icon - what `D - Sidebar` draws in its `Open=No` variant.

components.name: EvSlider
components.summary: A slider lets users select a value or range by dragging a handle along a track, giving direct, continuous control over a bounded numeric input.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: A single number, or a `[lower, upper]` pair when `range` is on.

props.name: range
props.description: Adds the second handle, filling between the two.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Shows the current value beneath the handle.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Required when there is no visible label.

components.name: EvSwitch
components.summary: A switch toggles a single setting on or off, taking effect immediately. It pairs a sliding control with a label, and supports active, disabled, and error states.

props.name: error
props.description: Paints the track in the error colour, on or off.

props.name: text
props.description: Label rendered inside the track, beside the thumb.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label beside the switch.

props.name: subtext
props.description: Subtext rendered under the visible label.

props.name: labelPlacement
props.description: Position of the visible label/subtext relative to the switch.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name when no visible label is provided.

components.name: EvTab
components.summary: One tab in a Tabs strip; its value selects it, and it takes the variant from the Tabs around it.

props.name: value
props.description: Value this tab selects.

components.name: EvTabs
components.summary: Tabs let users switch between related views within the same context, showing one panel at a time. They come in a segmented (pill) style and a line (underline) style.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the tab list.

components.name: EvTag
components.summary: A tag is a small label that marks an item with a keyword, category, or attribute. It can carry a leading icon and an optional close button to remove it.

props.name: removable
props.description: Renders the trailing dismiss button and enables the `remove` event.

props.name: removeLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the dismiss button.

components.name: EvTagGroup
components.summary: Lays out a set of tags, wrapping or scrolling, and hands them one shared variant.

props.name: variant
props.description: Cascades to every `EvTag` inside that does not set its own.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Figma's `Spacing`: 4px (`default`) or 8px (`loose`).

props.name: type
props.description: Figma's `Type`: wrap onto more lines, or one line that scrolls.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the group.

components.name: EvTextarea
components.summary: A multi-line text input for collecting longer free-form content. It supports a character counter, validation, optional icons, a scrollbar, and the same interaction states as InputField.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: `.InputType` variant `Placeholder-default` - 14px, shown while empty.

props.name: label
props.description: `.InputType` variant `Title` - 12px, shown while empty instead of the placeholder.

props.name: required
props.description: The `Mandatory` boolean on `.InputType`: appends the red asterisk.

props.name: rows
props.description: Drives the fixed height: `rows` x 16px line-height + 16px padding.

props.name: showCount
props.description: Figma's `Has Validation Text`: the trailing character counter.

props.name: validationText
props.description: The leading message. The board only reveals it in the two Error states.

props.name: validationTextEnd
props.description: Trailing helper text. `showCount` wins when both are set.

props.name: hasScroll
props.description: Figma's `Has Scroll`: reveals the 2px scrollbar once the body overflows.

components.name: EvTimePicker
components.summary: A scrolling wheel for picking a time - 24-hour, with seconds, or AM/PM - with Apply and Cancel.

props.name: format
props.description: Figma's `Variant`: which columns the wheel shows.

props.name: hasReset
props.description: Figma's `Has Reset Button`: the refresh glyph beside the value.

components.name: EvToast
components.summary: A toast is a brief, auto-dismissing notification that appears over the interface to confirm an action or surface a status message without interrupting the user's flow.

props.name: variant
props.description: `Type` of the Figma `Toast` set.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting line. The board reaches it through `Type=WithDescription`; setting it here switches the toast to that layout whatever the variant.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Renders the dismiss cross and enables the `close` event.

components.name: EvToggle
components.summary: A toggle is a two-state button that switches an option on or off. Use it standalone, or grouped in a ToggleGroup for a set of related single- or multi-select options.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Pressed state.

components.name: EvToggleGroup
components.summary: A labelled row of toggles that share one variant and size.

props.name: size
props.description: Sets the gap and cascades default size to child `EvToggle`s.

props.name: variant
props.description: Cascades default variant to child `EvToggle`s.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the group.

components.name: EvTooltip
components.summary: A tooltip is a small dark overlay that appears on hover or focus to give a short, contextual hint about an element, with an arrow pointing back to its trigger.

props.name: placement
props.description: Which side of the trigger the bubble sits on.

props.name: text
props.description: Body text. Use the `content` slot for anything richer.

props.name: title
props.description: Optional bold heading inside the bubble.

props.name: open
props.description: Take control of visibility instead of letting hover and focus drive it.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Renders the close button in the title row.

components.name: EvTree
components.summary: A tree displays hierarchical data as nested, expandable rows — files and folders, categories, or org structures — letting users drill into nested levels while keeping their place.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the tree.

components.name: EvTreeItem
components.summary: One row of a Tree: indented by level, with a chevron that expands its children and an optional checkbox for selection.

props.name: level
props.description: Nesting depth, 1-8. The design system only draws eight.

props.name: hasChild
props.description: Figma's `Has Child`: the node can be opened, so it gets a chevron. Defaults to true, as the component set does.

props.name: hasCheckbox
props.description: Figma's `Has Checkbox`: puts a selection box before the label.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Renders the checkbox's dash, for a partly-selected subtree.

props.name: checkboxLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the checkbox, which has no visible label of its own.
